The scheduled release canary drift job passes
description: `python scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py --repo BenchBox-dev/benchbox` against live GitHub on 2026-10-23 reports `develop-squash-only: required checks ['core','docs','explorer','hold','oracle-gate','oracle-review','results-data','tooling'], expected ['core','docs','explorer','hold','oracle-review','results-data','tooling']`. The live ruleset requires `oracle-gate`; the expected list parsed from `docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md` does not include it, so the daily release canary's drift job fails with a blocking finding unrelated to any change. Update the runbook's required-checks list for `develop-squash-only` (and any doc that repeats it, such as docs/internal/merge-queue-governance.md and oracle-review-v2.md) to match the live ruleset, then run the drift check and the release canary to confirm it is green.
